messages.subject: Vendor selection - warehouse racking
messages.body:
Team,

After comparing the three bids, we decided to go with Northgate Supplies for the warehouse racking contract. Price and lead time were both better than the other two vendors.

Jane Miller
Operations Lead, Example Corp

messages.subject: RE: Vendor selection - warehouse racking
messages.body:
Got it, thanks Jane. I'll still need to follow up with legal on the contract redlines before we sign anything.

--
